00047 MultiSliderUGenInternal::MultiSliderUGenInternal(UGen const& input, MultiSlider *_sliders) throw()
00048 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, input.getNumChannels()-1),
00049     sliders(_sliders->attachToMultiSliderUGenInternal() ? _sliders : 0),
00050     values(sliders && input.getNumChannels() ? new double[input.getNumChannels()] : 0)
00051 {
00052     inputs[Input] = input;
00053         
00054     if(values)
00055         memset(values, 0, input.getNumChannels() * sizeof(double));
00056     
00057     if(sliders && sliders->isValidComponent())
00058     {
00059         sliders->getInterceptsMouseClicks(oldClick, oldChildClick);
00060         sliders->setInterceptsMouseClicks(false, false);
00061         
00062         sliders->setNumSliders(input.getNumChannels());
00063         for(int i = 0; i < input.getNumChannels(); i++)
00064         {
00065             values[i] = sliders->getSlider(i)->getValue();
00066         }
00067         
00068         startTimer(40);
00069     }
00070 }
00071 
00072 MultiSliderUGenInternal::~MultiSliderUGenInternal()
00073 {
00074     stopTimer();
00075     
00076     if(sliders && sliders->isValidComponent())
00077     {
00078         sliders->detachFromMultiSliderUGenInternal();
00079         sliders->setInterceptsMouseClicks(oldClick, oldChildClick);
00080     }
00081     
00082     delete [] values;
00083 }
00084 
00085 void MultiSliderUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00086 {
00087     const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00088             
00089     for(int channel = 0; channel < getNumChannels(); channel++)
00090     {
00091         float *outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00092         const float *inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00093         
00094         if(values) values[channel] = *inputSamples;
00095         
00096         memcpy(outputSamples, inputSamples, blockSize * sizeof(float));
00097     }
00098 }
00099 
00100 void MultiSliderUGenInternal::timerCallback()
00101 {
00102     for(int i = 0; i < getNumChannels(); i++)
00103     {
00104         sliders->getSlider(i)->setValue(values[i], true, false);
00105     }
00106 }

00108 MultiSliderUGen::MultiSliderUGen(UGen const& input, MultiSlider *sliders) throw()
